nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_p$ with $|A| \ge 2$, This is the case $h = 2$ of the wanted Dias da Silva–Hamidoune theorem, written in its form. It is the Erdős–Heilbronn bound, since $2|A| - 4 + 1 = 2|A| - 3$ when $|A| \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Dias da Silva–Hamidoune theorem for h = 2

nodes.summary: Let `F` be a field, `f` a polynomial in the variables `xᵢ` (`i ∈ σ`, finitely many), `Sᵢ` nonempty finite subsets of `F`, and `gᵢ = ∏_{s ∈ Sᵢ} (xᵢ - s)`. If `f` vanishes at every point of `∏ᵢ Sᵢ`, then `f = ∑ᵢ hᵢ gᵢ` for polynomials `hᵢ` with `deg hᵢ ≤ deg f - deg gᵢ` (N. Alon, "Combinatorial Nullstellensatz", Combin. Probab. Comput. 8 (1999), Theorem 1.1). The degree bound is stated as `deg hᵢ + deg gᵢ ≤ deg f`,…
nodes.title: Combinatorial Nullstellensatz, Theorem 1.1

nodes.summary: Let `F` be a field and `f` a polynomial in finitely many variables `xᵢ` (`i ∈ σ`) of total degree `∑ᵢ tᵢ`, where the coefficient of the monomial `∏ᵢ xᵢ^{tᵢ}` in `f` is nonzero. If `Sᵢ ⊆ F` are finite sets with `|Sᵢ| > tᵢ`, then there is a point `s ∈ ∏ᵢ Sᵢ` with `f(s) ≠ 0` (N. Alon, "Combinatorial Nullstellensatz", Combin. Probab. Comput. 8 (1999), Theorem 1.2).
nodes.title: Combinatorial Nullstellensatz, Theorem 1.2

nodes.summary: Let `K` be a finite field and `f_j` (`j ∈ s`) polynomials in finitely many variables `xᵢ` (`i ∈ σ`) whose total degrees sum to less than the number of variables. If the `f_j` have a common zero `x`, then they have another common zero `y ≠ x` (N. Alon, "Combinatorial Nullstellensatz", Combin. Probab. Comput. 8 (1999), Theorem 3.1, stated there over the prime fields `ℤ_p` and proved with Theorem 1.2; here it is…
nodes.title: Chevalley–Warning theorem, existence form

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $H_i = \{x \in F^n : \sum_j a_{ij} x_j = b_i\}$, $i < m$, finitely many affine hyperplanes. If every vertex of the cube $\{0, 1\}^n$ other than one vertex $v$ lies on some $H_i$, and $v$ lies on none, then $m \ge n$. The bound is tight: the $n$ hyperplanes $x_j = 1$ cover every vertex except $0$ (the test module checks these hypotheses for every $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$).
nodes.title: Covering the cube minus a vertex by hyperplanes (Alon–Füredi)

nodes.summary: If $p$ is a prime and $A$ a nonempty subset of $\mathbb{Z}_p$, then the restricted sumset $2^{\wedge}A = \{a + a' : a, a' \in A,\ a \ne a'\}$ satisfies Natural-number subtraction makes the bound $0$ when $|A| = 1$, where the paper's $2|A| - 3$ is negative. The bound is attained by arithmetic progressions; the test module checks $A = \{0, 1, 2\} \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_7$, whose restricted sums are $\{1, 2, 3\}$.
nodes.title: Erdős–Heilbronn conjecture (Dias da Silva–Hamidoune theorem)
